_comment: Zone unlock quests (Boss 2026-11-17: 'a quest that unlocks the mummy map: character level 15'). Key = zone id from zones.json. A zone with an entry opens only when EVERY step is met (plus the old rule: the zone before it has its boss beaten). Step types: boss_beaten {zone}, card_level {min, count: how many cards must be at least that level} and card_level_all {min: EVERY card the player owns must be at least that level; 0 cards = not met}. Main quest chain (Boss 2026-11-21): these quests in map order are the MAIN quests of the Quests panel; quest N shows locked until quest N-1 is done. Text placeholders: {cur} {target}. All numbers and texts are PLACEHOLDERS the Boss can change here without code. To add the next zone's quest, add another key.
